about.story: I am Harshit, an aspiring AI Engineer and Full-Stack Developer driven by a passion for solving real-world problems through clean code, advanced machine learning models, and breathtaking user interfaces. I bridge the gap between heavy backend calculations, model orchestration, and front-end motion graphics. Whether building high-converting landing pages or structuring deep learning models, my goal is absolute precision and unmatched aesthetic quality.

Utilizing AI tools for branding, graphic design, and video editing

projects.name: AI-Powered Analytics SaaS
projects.description: A high-fidelity data console rendering real-time AI usage statistics and cost summaries.
projects.longDescription: This project delivers a complete enterprise-scale analytical tool that maps API requests, token counts, and performance curves. Using Next.js Server Actions, Prisma, and Tailwind CSS, it offers a real-time tracking panel with fully interactive SVG graphs, charts, and downloadable reports.
projects.challengesSolved: Architected clean database indexes and edge functions to process millions of real-time usage statistics without page delay.

projects.name: Spotify Glassmorphic Clone
projects.description: A high-fidelity clone of Spotify web player with interactive glassmorphism UI.
projects.longDescription: An audio player powered by the Spotify Web Playback SDK, built to showcase complex frontend state architecture. It utilizes Framer Motion for slide animations, Tailwind for responsive spacing, and a Node.js middleware server to handle OAuth 2.0 user credentials securely.
projects.challengesSolved: Synchronized asynchronous song play actions and playlist transitions smoothly with minimum UI jitter.

projects.name: Tracker.gg Gamer Portal
projects.description: A gaming stats dashboard tracking multiplayer statistics, achievements, and matches.
projects.longDescription: A gaming stats application that pulls real-time information from competitive shooter APIs. Featuring a custom routing layout, caching pipelines, and detailed player graphs, this tracker replicates the functionality of Tracker.gg with dark futuristic elements.
projects.challengesSolved: Designed intelligent data caching algorithms to query player statistics without getting blocked by gaming API rate limits.

projects.name: Futuristic SaaS Platform
projects.description: A premium web platform built to automate corporate document writing using AI LLM agents.
projects.longDescription: Currently under active development, this product leverages LangChain and Python ML models to automate complex report writing. It features an interactive node-based editor, drag-and-drop workspace triggers, and collaborative sockets.
projects.challengesSolved: Designed scalable node models to handle drag, drop, connection, and real-time execution outputs simultaneously.
